scenarios: before a connection: the bounded sends are refused at once and the control writes do nothing
connected: the session is the hello; control writes go out unbounded; a taken send resolves
a write that fails rejects with its error
a write the pipe never takes is rejected at the frame deadline, not before; a late outcome counts for nothing
sas and a grant are bounded the same way
the connection closing rejects every pending send and emits close; later sends are refused
close deactivates and ends; a send already handed over settles from its own outcome
after authentication: a desktop change updates the session; challenges and errors are emitted

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
